speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The gospel this morning is the long one. A quarter is already gone, and I am not yet at the cross. I will not hurry a passion to suit a dinner.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The parish is in black. Look at your own cloth if you need a picture. I am not painting one for you, and I am not looking up to find a face.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Black in this house, and black in the aisle. We are not trimming the day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not trimming it. I have no pen on my knee. The long reading can be long.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The ledge is bare. Nobody has brought a branch. The cloth is heavier than Sunday.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Bare is correct. A branch would be a lie on a day like this. Hear the reading. The garden, the hall, the long way. I will not make it short for the restless.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear it. I am not taking a note of it. What I wrote this morning is at home, beside a book, and it can stay there.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Home is the place for a margin. This aisle is for standing. You stood Sunday. You can stand today.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: He was delivered, and they cried, and the week turned. You heard that on Sunday. Today you will hear what a turn costs. I do not ask you to admire the cost. I ask you to stay until it is said.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will stay. I am tired, and the staying is the work. I have not come to furnish a speech out of your gospel.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is no bread on the ledge, and no cup. I looked, from habit.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then stop looking. This is not a day for the table. Mark me. We are here to stand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am standing in the south aisle with the house, and my knee is empty. I am not counting the pews into a story.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then keep the knee empty. The long gospel is not a table of names. When I am through it, you may go. Not before, and not with a sentence you invented in the middle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No sentence. I have one question at home, and I am not asking it here.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I shift for the people behind? The black coats are close.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Shift a hand's breadth, and no more. We are not making a lane. This is not a procession.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: No procession. No palms. No haste. I am going on. Those who have stood this far can stand the rest. I have not looked at you, and I am not about to begin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then go on. I will be here when you finish, and I will have written nothing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Written nothing is the right sum for this aisle. I will take you home with that, and with nothing added.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A quarter gone, and the cross still ahead. Stay for the cost of it. I have no second lesson hiding under this one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am stayed. The question I wrote is about a chronicle, and it is not this gospel. I am not mixing them in your aisle.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will stop looking along the pews. Bare ledge. Black cloth. That is the whole of what I have.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And it is enough. A long morning can be borne without a history of it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Bear it, then. I am not finished. You will know when I am, because I will stop, and not because a neighbour has decided.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We will know. Until then I am a man in a black coat with an empty knee.
